backend/main.mo: Defines the main actor with data models, state maps, counters, access control, and race performance comparison utilities.
backend/migration.mo: Implements migration logic that upgrades stored user profiles by assigning default balances where missing.
feature_evidence.json: Contains feature evidence records mapping features to affected frontend files and metadata.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists prewritten summaries for many frontend files in key application areas.
frontend/index.css: Sets Tailwind base styles and defines light/dark theme CSS variables.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading the React application and root container.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Configures the router and application layout with routes for core pages and admin sections.
frontend/src/assets/generatedAssets.ts: Exports paths to generated image asset packs for cars, trails, banners, and the app logo.
frontend/src/components/admin/AccessDeni: Displays an access denied message with a return-to-dashboard button.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminAudit: Renders a simple audit log UI with sample static entries.
frontend/src/components/admin/AdminGuard: Protects admin-only routes by checking identity and admin status before rendering children.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Dialog that prompts new authenticated users to enter and save a username and display name via profile creation API.
frontend/src/components/layout/AppLayout: Main app layout with header, navigation, and login/logout handling tied to Internet Identity and admin state.
frontend/src/components/race/CarViewer3D: 3D car viewer using three.js to render and animate simplified car models with color and model‑based geometry.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackCarMar: Renders a small stylized car icon for track UI, adjusting shape and color based on model and CarColor.
frontend/src/components/race/TrackVisual: Displays race lanes showing player and optional ghost opponent positions using TrackCarMarker components.
frontend/src/components/race/WordZoneInd: Shows the user's current word zone, WPM range, and target word count in compact or full card form.
frontend/src/hooks/useActiveCar.ts: Hook for storing and retrieving the selected car ID in localStorage.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches the backend actor based on identity, refreshing dependent queries when identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Hooks for checking whether the caller is an admin and retrieving the caller's user role from the actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useEconomy.ts: Mutation hooks for admin coin grants and race completion, currently disabled pending backend support.
frontend/src/hooks/useGhostOpponents.ts: Stub hook for ghost opponents, always returning no ghosts due to disabled backend support.
frontend/src/hooks/useHolidays.ts: React Query hooks for holidays, currently disabled and returning empty results or errors.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity context and login/logout handling using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/useInventory.ts: Fetches the current user's inventory using their Internet Identity principal.
frontend/src/hooks/useLeaderboards.ts: Stubbed leaderboard query hook that returns empty data until backend support exists.
frontend/src/hooks/useMotd.ts: Simple MOTD hook returning a static welcome message.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of data-fetching and mutation hooks for user profiles, inventory, roles, and car catalog via the actor API.
frontend/src/hooks/useTeams.ts: Stubbed team-related hooks that are disabled and return empty data or errors.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS setup defining light and dark theme color variables and global styles.
frontend/src/lib/adminCommandParser.ts: Parses admin commands such as creating titles, setting MOTD, adding text, and granting coins.
frontend/src/lib/raceMetrics.ts: Utility functions to compute WPM, accuracy, and race metrics.
frontend/src/lib/raceTextGeneration.ts: Generates race text using word pools and user WPM heuristics, with helpers for storing and retrieving WPM.
frontend/src/lib/wordZones.ts: Defines word zones based on WPM and provides functions to map WPM to zones and select a target word count.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Initializes the React app with query client and Internet Identity providers.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminBannersPag: Placeholder page for managing banner designs with a simple card layout.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarsPage.t: Admin page stub for car inventory management with a coming-soon message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCarTemplat: Placeholder interface for managing car templates, showing a basic card message.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminCustomizeI: Provides navigation links to various customization management sections like cars, templates, and titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminEconomyToo: Admin tools for granting TRP Coins, currently disabled, with form validation and alerts.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminHomePage.t: Main admin dashboard linking to text, customization, economy, MOTD, and management tools.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminManagement: Interface to grant or revoke admin access using Principal IDs with validation and feedback.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminMotdPage.t: Placeholder page for configuring the message of the day.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminNitrosPage: Placeholder interface for managing nitro effects.
Stub page for managing race texts with a simple card layout.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTitlesPage: Static admin page with a placeholder card for managing player titles.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminTrailsPage: Static admin page showing a placeholder interface for managing trail effects.
frontend/src/pages/admin/AdminUpdateAssi: Interactive admin tool that parses natural-language commands and can execute limited actions like granting TRP coins.
frontend/src/pages/admin/TextDemoPage.ts: Placeholder page displaying a basic text demo interface.
frontend/src/pages/CustomizePage.tsx: Renders the customization interface where users view and select owned cars and other cosmetics.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Displays the main dashboard with shortcuts and stats, handling both authenticated and guest views.
frontend/src/pages/LeaderboardsPage.tsx: Shows leaderboard category tabs and a placeholder message for upcoming leaderboard data.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's profile details and stats, with loading and login-required states.
frontend/src/pages/RaceHistoryPage.tsx: Shows a login gate and a placeholder section for upcoming race history features.
frontend/src/pages/RaceLobbyPage.tsx: Provides the race lobby UI, calculates preview word zones, and lets users start different race modes.
frontend/src/pages/RacePage.tsx: Implements the typing race experience, generating race text, tracking user input, computing WPM/accuracy, animating progress, and saving results before navigating to the results page.
frontend/src/pages/RaceResultsPage.tsx: Displays stored race results including WPM, accuracy, and time, handles login-related save status messaging, and provides navigation options after a race.
frontend/src/pages/ShopPage.tsx: Shows the car shop where logged‑in users browse car models, select colors, view ownership status, and purchase variants with error handling.
frontend/src/pages/SystemPage.tsx: Provides an admin‑restricted interface for managing seasonal themes and custom holidays, including adding and removing holiday entries.
frontend/src/pages/TeamDetailsPage.tsx: Displays detailed information about a team, including founder status, membership, limits, and balance, with conditional UI for missing or loading teams.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPage.tsx: Displays a list of teams and allows users to create a new team with balance validation and dialog UI.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for reading, persisting, and clearing URL and session-based parameters.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending theme colors, animations, typography, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing current features, pending requests, and app state for a 3D car game.
